quests.title: Danger? Keep Away!

dialogue.t: Huh? Why does Paimon feel like there's an extra pool here all of a sudden? What does that sign say?
"Danger — Keep Away!" What does that mean?
It means exactly what it says.
Wah! Sandrone... You made Paimon jump! Did you put this sign here?
Yes. With the intention of keeping any curious cats well away.
What's so special about this pool?
It's full of piranhas.
Wha—!?
Haha, just kidding. Don't tell me you actually believed that?
I learned that a few fish in the aquarium are highly territorial and can get rather aggressive. So, I moved them here.
Don't scare Paimon like that! So, this place is like a special quarantine zone for aggro fishies?
Exactly, the water in this pool is much deeper, and there's a lot more space. It helps calm down the more territorial fish.
I also asked Sigewinne at the Fortress of Meropide for some special bait to help mellow them out a bit.
Oh, wow... So, you really do care about the fishies' well-being!
I don't think anyone wants to see the aquarium turn into a blood bath.
That's for sure! Anyway, why don't you leave this to us?
If you insist. When the fish in the pool feel comfortable enough to swim to the surface, it means they're on the mend.
So once they're all relaxed and happy, we can put them back in the aquarium?
Where you put them is up to you. All I'm responsible for is scooping up the unruly ones and moving them here in the first place.
Understood! But that sign is way too scary. Maybe we can change it for something a little less... terrifying?
Hmm... If you want. They're your fish, so I'll leave it up to you.

quests.description: Sandrone seems to be looking for us…
